thread:
kevin: FYI saw a customer hit a double-charge in streaming when a mid-stream toolcall was truncated then retried. logs attached but short summary below.

maria: link?

kevin: ```
2026-03-15T09:11:02Z POST /v1/stream session=ses-42 prefix_len=128 -> toolcall tc-7 invoked
2026-03-15T09:11:03Z toolcall tc-7 truncated (client timeout) -> router fallback to region-b
2026-03-15T09:11:04Z client reconnect resume_token=rt-8 -> replays from prefix 120 -> toolcall retried tc-7'
Ledger: provisional credits for tc-7 + confirmed credits for tc-7' -> double charge
```

sasha: Is this the case where the provisional ledger row never got reconciled/merged? :thinking:

anita: I think the race is heartbeat ack vs toolcall commit. If the commit comes after the provisional tombstone TTL we end up with two rows.

jordan: Could be. Also if resume_token points to a different route_id (fallback routing) we attribute final charge to route B while provisional was route A. Console shows both.

alex: UX question — do we show provisional credits in the console now? Users keep opening support tickets about "Why do I see phantom tokens?"

kevin: We currently surface provisional in the billing timeline but not clearly labeled; that makes it worse. Proposal: treat provisional as "pending" and only show confirmed at default view, with an opt-in toggler.

maria: From infra/telemetry side we need stronger signals. Suggest adding a "confirmed" boolean to the meter proto and a stable "logical_request_id" that survives route handoffs.

sasha: Adding confirmed flag makes sense. But will router always be able to mark finalization? When toolcall is async we sometimes finalize from the sidecar. We need a single canonical finalizer.

kevin: Implementation idea: meter events flow as provisional event (provisional=true, logical_request_id=LRID) then final event (provisional=false, same LRID, final_token_count=N, attribution_route=route_id). Router or sidecar that owns finalization emits final event. If final event arrives and a provisional row exists, update it instead of inserting.

anita: That would avoid creating two separate ledger rows. But what about cases where finalizer is on a different host and can't find the provisional row (GC)? We need TTLs and a backfill job to reconcile stale provisionals older than X hours.

jordan: Also edge: if resume_token is reused by client across different logical requests (bad client), LRID must be different. So LRID must be generated by the initial handler and returned to client as opaque.

alex: For the console: add a column "status" with values pending/confirmed/failed and a hover tooltip explaining provisional mechanics + a link to support KB. Default filter = confirmed.

maria: Telemetry fields to add: ["logical_request_id", "session_id", "chunk_offset", "provisional", "final_token_count", "attribution_route", "toolcall_id", "resume_token_hash"]. We'll need to version the proto.

sasha: One more thought: to avoid billing surprises, could router temporarily reserve credits on provisional and show as "reserved" rather than debited? UX/Acct needs to decide whether provisional reduces available quota.

kevin: Good point. For quotas we should treat provisional as reserved capacity (affects concurrency quota) but not count towards billable tokens until confirmed. That avoids immediate billing but still prevents abuse.

anita: Operational: backfill job to reconcile last 7 days, mark confirmed where final event exists, and surface diffs. I can scope the job.

jordan: Could we instead unify ledger by making provisional rows have a pointer to final row id when reconciled? Might be simpler than update-in-place.

maria: Both are fine; update-in-place easier for UI. Pointer model needs more joins.

kevin: Action items I will take: 1) PR to add confirmed+LRID to meter proto, 2) router/sidecar change to emit final event with same LRID, 3) console change to default-filter confirmed and add status column, 4) infra backfill job for 7 days.

alex: sgtm. Please include QA checks for canary. Also note billing/legal should sign off on reserved vs billed semantics.

deploy-bot: canary: meter-proto-v2 rolled to 5% traffic at 2026-03-15T09:12Z :thumbsup:

sasha: Nice. One small ask — include a debug flag in the final event with the original provisional timestamp so we can trace races.

kevin: will add. I'll file tickets and ping infra + billing. Thanks all :pray:
